elements.requirement: The interception of a communication is authorised under section 44 of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016 if the sender and the intended recipient of the communication have each consented to its interception.

elements.requirement: The interception of a communication is authorised under section 44 of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016 if the communication is one sent by, or intended for, a person who has consented to the interception, and surveillance by means of that interception has been authorised under Part 2 of the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000 or the Regulation of Investigatory Powers (Scotland) Act 2000 (2000 asp 11).
